pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Kubescape is a Kubernetes security platform. Its CLI scans clusters, YAML manifests, and Helm charts for misconfigurations, RBAC issues, image vulnerabilities, and compliance against frameworks such as NSA-CISA and MITRE ATT&CK.
This package installs the statically linked binary published in upstream releases. The upstream go.sum for v4.0.12 is 2649 lines (pulling in anchore/grype, anchore/syft, sigstore/cosign, moby/buildkit, docker/cli, and multiple cloud SDKs) -- too large to reasonably build and maintain from source in this overlay.
